thread:
maria_finance: Quick flag: during last night's traffic spike we under-counted billable tokens for a handful of requests that were short-circuited by the new throttler. Customer 'BlueWave' reported an unexpected credit on their portal.

sam_backend: which throttler path? rate_limit_v2 or the new fast-path?

maria_finance: fast-path. It returns 429 before the metering hook fires. App logs show the requests and token totals but ledger rows are missing.

julie_billing: Can you share the ledger vs log diff? I need numbers to draft a credit memo.

maria_finance: pasted quick query I ran:
```sql
-- requests that were flagged rate_limited but have no ledger entry
SELECT req.request_id, req.customer_id, req.tokens, req.created_at
FROM requests req
LEFT JOIN ledger_entries le ON le.request_id = req.request_id
WHERE req.customer_id = 'cust_bluewave' AND req.rate_limited = true AND le.request_id IS NULL;
```

ops-eng: ops can run a targeted backfill. Proposal: backfill only requests older than 90 minutes, add an idempotency key 'backfill_v1' and skip if ledger already has that key. Also put a 5m rate limit on the backfill writer.

sam_backend: agree on backfill constraints. I'll also drop a quick patch so the throttler emits a minimal metering event even for early 429s. Hotfix will be small: call metering.emit(...) before short-circuit return.

kevin_fpna: please estimate the expected credit amount and GL account. Anything over $750 needs director sign-off.

anita_bd: Heads-up from BD: BlueWave flagged this via their AM; they want confirmation & timeline. Please loop me into the customer reply.

julie_billing: Once ops posts the CSV of missing request_ids and totals, I'll compute the dollar value and create a provisional credit memo. If it's < $750 we can credit on next invoice; if > $750 we do an invoice adj with approvals.

billing-bot: "Backfill job scheduled (id: backfill-2026-03-23-19). Status: scheduled."

maria_finance: CSV from ops attached (bluewave_missing_179999.csv). Totals: 142,510 tokens missing -> $14.25. Seems small.

kevin_fpna: $14.25 ok to approve; book to GL 6702 (customer credits). No director approval needed.

ops-eng: Backfill ran for records older than 90m. Inserted 48 ledger rows with idempotency key backfill_v1. No conflicts.

sam_backend: PR merged for throttler hotfix and deployed to staging; will canary to prod in 30m.

julie_billing: Credit memo drafted for $14.25 and queued to be applied to the next invoice. Draft note: "Metering discrepancy during rate-limited window; credit applied." Will send to Anita for customer reply.

anita_bd: thanks team, I'll confirm with the customer once the memo posts.

maria_finance: closing loop: monitor for any other customers affected and add a test to alert when rate_limited=true but ledger_missing_count > 0 for 5+ requests in 1h.

sam_backend: added an alert ticket: ENG-5123.

maria_finance: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
